environment.hardware: Training and frozen evaluation used NVIDIA H200 143771 MiB, driver 580.173.02; aggregation used CPU. Training disabled JAX GPU preallocation to coexist with an unrelated process.

mathematics.assertion_tested: For PPO policies trained independently from the same original seed-30--34 checkpoints for 32 updates at overwrite probabilities 0.05 or 0.30, compute the finite-panel deterministic-mode expected discounted return at the matching probability and subtract the same-seed frozen normal-continuation policy return. Decide whether the five-seed mean improves and report every paired sign, normal-kernel retention, sampled-policy performance, risky-harvest exposure, and adaptation loss.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integer episode, transition, trigger, event, and loss counts; path returns and grouped probability polynomials use IEEE-754 binary64 with discount 0.995.
mathematics.conventions: Each learned-policy condition is an equal-weight mean over five learner seeds, and each seed's exact mode value is an equal-weight mean over all 32 natural validation starts. For a fixed-kernel path with success s_i, length T_i, and risky-harvest count k_i, success is s_i(1-p)^k_i, discounted return is s_i*0.995^(T_i-1)*(1-p)^k_i, and overwrite-loss probability is 1-(1-p)^k_i. Existing fixed-kernel failure is counted separately from overwrite loss. A risky harvest is a valid harvest with positive pre-harvest inventory. Sampled policy evaluation is separate from the exact deterministic-mode computation.
inputs: Ten completed cell summaries, 320 update records, 40 retained checkpoint receipts and state files, and 40 preregistered evaluations under the canonical run root; their identities and budgets are checked by the committed summarizer.
non_claims: Neither 5%, 30%, nor an earlier policy-reference equality is an optimal-avoidance boundary.
The scripted zero-loss reference and frozen p=1 policy are not claimed optimal.
The p=0.30 versus p=0.05 outcome difference is not attributed to experience frequency alone.
Five learner seeds do not establish statistical significance or generalization beyond these policies, starts, budgets, and independent defect model.
The bounded calculation is not a universal theorem about rare-defect adaptation.

randomness.generator: JAX PRNG with learner seeds 30--34; action, environment, sampler, and a separate fold_in-derived defect stream are checkpointed or reproducibly derived. The p=0.05 and p=0.30 branches within a seed use the same initial actor-critic, Adam state, worker state, RNG state, and slot-indexed defect uniforms.

checks: All 10 preregistered jobs completed exactly 32 updates and 1,048,576 collector slots; the aggregate is 10,485,760 slots with 10,240 optimizer applications, zero teacher updates, and zero BC updates.
All update records were present and numerically ordered; retained checkpoints were exactly updates 0, 2, 8, and 32, and every serialized state matched its receipt hash.
Every evaluation train-state hash matched its checkpoint receipt, all rolling resume checkpoints were pruned, and no failed-job marker remained.

Within every seed, p=0.05 and p=0.30 origins had identical source and branch train-state hashes, worker-state hashes, optimizer steps, and source checkpoints; update-zero fixed-mode risk profiles were identical.
Execution sources and all three pinned prerequisite artifacts retained their launch hashes. End storage retained 7,902,925,979,648 free RAID bytes, above the declared peak-plus-reserve requirement.

The focused stochastic, checkpoint, exact-polynomial, and manifest suite passed 14 tests. The full repository run passed 504 tests and had nine provenance-sensitive failures: eight from authorized-source hash mismatches in Mine files outside this branch's experiment changes, and one from five stale historical spatial GPU source hashes, four outside this branch and one changed PACK source.
At p=0.05, paired return differences versus normal continuation had signs +,+,+,-,- and mean -0.013597437135750168. At p=0.30, they had signs +,+,+,+,0 and mean 0.07477838662649479.
The compact repository result was mechanically compared with the canonical raw result for both condition aggregates, all 10 seed rows, and all eight preregistered curve points.
result: Implementation and finite assertion verified in the stated range. At p=0.05 the final exact mode success rate was 0.95625 and expected return 0.8657421485479571, which was 0.013597437135750168 below normal continuation on average, with three positive and two negative seeds. At p=0.30 success was 0.8875 and return 0.8064508949076175, which was 0.07477838662649479 above normal continuation, with four positive seeds and one tie. The frozen p=1 policy remained better than normal continuation at p=0.05, so a higher-return frozen policy existed but was not reliably reacquired by the rare-experience branch under this budget.
residual_risks: The environment, exact-path evaluator, training runner, and aggregation code are internally authored. Pairing, checkpoint hashes, endpoint logic, and focused tests reduce but do not eliminate common-implementation error.

The exact mode computation assumes independent Bernoulli fires and uses the no-fire deterministic path; its correctness relies on the verified physical invariant that any first grain loss makes the three-grain target unreachable.
Binary64 finite sums were not independently recomputed at higher precision, although the reported contrasts are much larger than rounding error except the explicitly classified p=0.30 seed-34 tie.
PPO learning is randomized and only five learner seeds were run. Per-episode counts are not treated as independent learned-policy replications.
The full repository was not globally green because nine unrelated or stale-provenance checks failed; all directly scoped stochastic tests and result-integrity gates passed.
